description: This is a Python source file implementing an OpenAI-specific RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) ingestion class. The class manages the storage of files in OpenAI's vector store, leveraging OpenAI's built-in handling for embedding and chunking. It overrides storage and embedding methods to align with OpenAI's workflow, including creating vector stores, uploading files, and attaching files without manual embedding.
